summary: Trigger index generator's DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT resolves one directory level short (to <repo>/.opencode instead of <repo>), silently dropping the entire .opencode/skills and .opencode/install-guides corpus roots from the published trigger-index.json; masked only because .opencode/specs is a symlink to ../specs
fix: Add one more '..' hop to DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT (or derive it as path.resolve(SKILL_ROOT,'..','..')), regenerate trigger-index.json, and add a regression test asserting walkCorpus() returns at least one path under each CORPUS_ROOTS entry
